quality_assessment: Legitimate training content: advanced Facebook/Instagram ads tutorial by practitioner with 12 years, 3000+ clients, $200M+ spend. Stripped of boilerplate, transcription artifacts, nav UI.
portion_doctrine: Facebook/Instagram ads operate on 3-tier structure: campaign (objective/budget/strategy) > adset (audience/targeting/performance_goal) > ad (creative/copy/CTA). Core thesis: precise campaign objective selection + performance goal alignment determines Meta's machine learning optimization. Beginners should use Leads or Sales objectives, set daily budgets they can afford to lose, avoid artificial audience constraint, and let Meta expand beyond stated targeting criteria.
operating_rules: Buying type: Always use Auction, not Reservation (lower quality placements despite lower cost)
Campaign objective selection is load-bearing: directly controls available options and Meta's optimization engine
Campaign budget vs adset budget: Campaign-level auto-distributes by performance; adset-level gives manual control. Single adset campaigns = no difference
Daily budget preferred over lifetime budget: more flexible, more consistent spend, easier to scale, avoid learning phase restart
Budget mindset: set amount you could afford to lose but would sting slightly (sweet spot for engagement). No universal amount (varies $10-$5000/day by business)
Performance goal overrides campaign objective value: selecting wrong goal (e.g., 'maximize impressions' with leads campaign) tanks performance
Location targeting: advertise where customers are, not where you think prospects are richest. Let Meta distribute by performance
Custom audiences (warm) are suggestions, not hard constraints in suggest-audience section
Hard boundaries (controls section): location, minimum age, language. Soft boundaries (suggest-audience): detailed targeting, age range, gender
Placements: For leads/sales campaigns, use all 24 placements. For traffic objective only, deselect Audience Network (lower quality)
Ad creative format selection: image ads simpler for beginners, video ads perform well but higher lift. Carousels, advantage+ catalog ads are advanced
Ad copy pattern: problem statement + target callout > feature > benefit > scarcity > CTA in 2-3 sentences
Headline options: up to 5 variations. Test multiple to give Meta flexibility for persona matching
Call-to-action button: choose option matching next step (Learn More, Schedule Call, Get Quote, Shop Now depending on offer)
AI-generated variations: use as filter, not gospel. Some work great, some don't fit identity/offer, hybrid some need tweaking

Ad enhancements: turn off enhanced media text (keeps message consistent), translate text (only if you can fulfill in other languages), ad overlays if text-heavy already. Leave on: visual touchups, music overlay (customizable), text improvements, adapt multi-image
named_methods: Meta Business Manager account setup: primary control hub holding ad account, Facebook page, Instagram profile
Conversion location selection: website vs instant forms (website simpler for beginners, instant forms require form creation)
Performance goal selection (leads): maximize number of conversions vs maximize value of conversions (choose value-based if services differ in customer value)
Pixel tracking requirement: Meta Pixel must be installed for website conversion tracking; Conversions API recommended
Audience expansion within suggests: Meta can find people outside stated targeting if they match optimization goal
AI image expansion: Meta auto-crops, expands chosen media to fit more placements if enabled
Dynamic creative optimization: Meta tests different copy/image/CTA combos against personas identified in audience
Adset budget distribution strategy: if multiple adsets under one campaign budget, Meta auto-allocates based on performance
specific_tactics: Start with simple: 1 campaign, 1 adset, 1 ad to reduce friction and learn
Test multiple primary texts and headlines simultaneously: gives Meta flexibility to match personas within audience
Use warm audiences (people who've seen you before) for mentorship/expertise offers where credibility matters
Add testimonials/proof points on image ads: quick snippet format (e.g., '8x ROI in 3 weeks')
Use existing post option only if you lack confidence in creating new ads (sacrifices functionality vs native ad creation)
Optimize for square + vertical formats primarily: horizontal least important. Replace or crop if misaligned
Include person's photo in personal brand / mentorship ads: identity crucial for warm audience conversions
Turn off site links for beginners: reduces friction, keeps users focused on single conversion path (landing page)
Customize music overlay or disable if brand voice requires specific audio
Enable text improvements for flexibility unless copy structure breaks if elements move around
Review and manually filter all AI-generated copy/image variations: some will fail identity test or offer fit
Add custom audiences progressively: create and test later after initial campaign learns. Not required to start
Use value-based performance goals (not volume-based) for multi-service businesses where offer values differ significantly
prompts: Your campaign objective selection is load-bearing. Wrong objective = wrong Meta optimization engine. Which is your real goal: Leads, Sales, or Traffic?
Performance goal alignment: if you selected Leads, must you maximize conversions (volume) or value (quality by service type)?
Does your business require artificial location constraint or can Meta expand beyond it to find hidden gold?
Can you filter AI copy/image suggestions objectively? (This skill determines creative campaign success.)
Is your offer to warm audience (credibility-dependent) or cold (pure offer-driven)? This changes creative approach.
tools: Meta Business Manager: business.fas.com - primary hub for account structure
Ads Manager: for campaign creation and management (recommended over Business Suite for ad setup)
Meta Pixel: required for conversion tracking on website
Conversions API: recommended for advanced tracking alongside Pixel
Landing page builder: required if using website conversion location without instant forms
Image editor / carousel builder: for format-specific ad creative (square, vertical, horizontal)
A/B test framework: built into adset for testing different audience segments
Custom audience builder: for warm audience segmentation (visitors, email list, engagement, video viewers)
skills: Campaign objective selection based on business goal (Leads vs Sales vs Traffic)
Performance goal translation: matching service value structure to optimization directive
Audience targeting without artificial constraint: trusting Meta's expansion within suggests section
Creative filtering: identifying which AI variations actually fit identity and offer
Copy crafting: 6-7 elements in 2-3 sentences (problem + feature + benefit + scarcity + CTA)
Format-specific design: adapting square/vertical/horizontal for placement distribution
Pixel implementation and conversion event specification: setup requirement for performance goals
Budget psychology: finding the stinging-but-sustainable spend level for engagement
gates: Do not run ads without Pixel installed if using website conversion location
Do not select multiple special ad categories unless truly applicable (triggers account-level disapproval risk)
Do not select performance goal that contradicts campaign objective (e.g., Traffic goal on Sales campaign)
Do not artificially constrain audience location if Meta can profitably expand beyond it
Do not use personal identity in ads unless offer requires credibility signal (mentorship, consulting, personal brand)
Do not use existing post option unless new ad creation lacks confidence (sacrifices placement flexibility)
Do not add site links for beginners (confuses conversion path)
Do not enable enhanced media text, translate text, or enhanced CTA if they contradict brand voice or fulfillment capability
content_ideas: Case study: comparing warm vs cold audience ad performance for same offer (credibility-dependent vs price-driven)
Format guide: square vs vertical vs horizontal placement distribution and design implications
Copy template library: 6-element problem-feature-benefit-scarcity-CTA examples across verticals
Budget simulation: what $10/day vs $100/day vs $1000/day looks like in learning phase and scale
Pixel implementation guide: step-by-step conversion event tracking setup
Audience expansion case study: manual targeting vs suggested-audience expansion performance deltas
Creative filter checklist: objective questions for AI-generated variation evaluation
contradictions: Lower cost (Reservation buying) contradicts higher quality (Auction): instructor recommends Auction despite cost premium because quality audience outweighs savings
Broad location targeting contradicts perceived local market: instructor says advertise where customers are, not where you think rich prospects live; trust Meta to optimize
AI enhancements improve efficiency vs maintains brand consistency: balance required per enhancement (e.g., turn off media text overlay if already text-heavy)
weird_gold: Audience Network is considered 'lower quality placement' yet exists in default 24 placements; only deselect if traffic objective (non-conversion tracking) used
Lifetime budget causes 'lumpy' spend (front-load, back-load, or variable distribution) vs daily budget consistency; instructor prefers daily
Meta's AI image expansion can hallucinate person identity (tries to keep instructor's face but sometimes creates similar-but-different person); improved since 1 year ago
Custom audiences are 'warm' (previous interactions) yet live in 'suggest' section (soft constraints), not controls (hard constraints); means Meta can override
Ad copy structure: 'tired of wasting money' frame ticks 6 separate psychological boxes (problem, audience callout, agitation, feature, benefit, scarcity, CTA) in 7 words before benefit
Music overlays turn static images into short videos automatically; customizable or disableable per brand voice requirement
